I work in the mental health profession and can say that since everyone is unique that there isn't a magic bullet, though these are some good tips that apply to most of us:

Remind yourself why you're doing what you're doing in life. If it doesn't make sense, change it to something that does make sense and resonates with you as a person.

Be kind towards yourself, especially with the way that you talk to yourself inside your head.

Be around other people that are likely to be supportive. If there isn't anyone, find a way to be around others.

Exercise is good, even just a walk.

The guys who said meditate were absolutely correct, for some people it really helps, try finding some guided meditations on youtube.

As corny as this may sound, everybody needs hope in life so try and find out what gives you hope.

Finally we all need something to look forward to, try and arrange for something to cool to happen next week, a couple of weeks after that and so on. Could be a seeing a new movie with a friend, could be a trip somewhere, whatever excites you.

I hope they help, be well my friend.
